title: Hand drawn rage game with sonnet 5.5
author: Chance-Juggernaut983
selftext: Simple hand drawn style rage game with sonnet 5.5 I was giving it ideas for some unique art styles it could use and it decided to take its own direction from what I was saying and I kind of like it more not sure what the max capabilities of sonnet is compared to other models but for sonnet this is cool

comments.author: cutextwinklexcool
comments.body: Old-school Mario vibes on notebook paper, and “wet ink messes with your sense of direction” is such a fun idea for a trap. Did Sonnet come up with that too?

replies.author: Chance-Juggernaut983
replies.body: I gave it some ideas for traps that one inverts your controls so the left arrow is right and the right is left its pretty cool it’s only 5 levels but I want to add more idk how good sonnet is compared to things like opus but this is kind of cool for what I have seen for sonnet  do you have any ideas for traps?
